rubric.statement: The program feeds at least one demo into the two-step prediction and proves that the demo text lands in the first-stage main-LM `messages`, because `TwoStepAdapter.format()` inserts formatted demos between the system prompt and the live user message.

The program proves the extraction request does not inherit demos by inspecting the extraction-model `messages` and showing that the second stage is built from `ChatAdapter(..., demos=[], inputs={"text": completion})`, so only the main completion is forwarded.
The extraction-stage prompt inspection reflects the generated extractor signature: it uses a single `text` input plus the original output fields, rather than reusing the original task input schema.
The proof separately captures the recorded `messages` for both LM calls, so the conclusion is grounded in the actual first-stage and second-stage payloads instead of only the final prediction output.
